podcast.title: Future Value of Vinyl
podcast.body: Ariana Grande's vinyl records, despite high sales, are not expected to hold significant future value, as her typical audience is not seen as long-term collectors, leading to a projected decline in market value over time. "tienes a Ariana Grande [...] el tipo de público que tienen estos artistas no es de coleccionista, no es de compradorexigente por cómo he evolucionado la historia de la música, este tipo de artistas tienden a acabar en las tanquetas 15, 20 años después de todo a un dólar."

podcast.title: Loyal Fanbase Contribution
podcast.body: Ariana Grande is cited as an artist whose loyal fanbase contributes significantly to achieving number one debuts. Their eagerness to consume anything she releases, often through digital purchases and streams, creates pent-up demand that can propel a song to the top of the charts instantly. "a number one debut reflects pent up demand by an artist's loyal fan base. Say the fans of Justin Bieber or Ariana Grande."
